methodology: Conservative public-evidence classification. L-levels follow the 2026 Path to Recursive Self-Improving Agents framework where possible; E-levels are an RSI Observatory editorial evidence ladder.

dimensions.scope: What part of the evolving system changes? Model, harness, data system, trainer, improvement mechanism, or research process.
dimensions.depth: L1 manual; L2 assisted; L3 programmatic self-improvement with a fixed improver; L4 bounded RSI where the improvement mechanism is modifiable; L5 general RSI across broad evolving domains.
dimensions.evidence: E0 claim; E1 public artifact; E2 executable evaluation; E3 held-out persistent gain; E4 bounded meta-improvement; E5 independent multi-generation replication.

systems.name: Darwin Gödel Machine
systems.basis: The 2026 self-improving-agent survey grades DGM L4; public code evolves the agent implementation and retains empirically validated variants. L4 is survey-aligned; E4 is an editorial reading of author-reported self-modification, not an isolated measurement of accelerating improvement or independent replication.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: Gödel Agent
systems.basis: The 2026 survey grades Gödel Agent L4; the agent is explicitly self-referential and can rewrite its own logic. L4 is survey-aligned; E4 is an editorial reading of author-reported self-modification, not an isolated measurement of accelerating improvement or independent replication.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: OpenRSI / OpenMLE
systems.basis: Authors report operator training and held-out transfer, and frame this as bounded meta-evolution. The reviewed sources do not establish autonomous repeated modification of the training/update mechanism; E4 is withheld.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: Recuris
systems.basis: Execution evidence drives persistent memory/harness updates; public evidence does not require the update mechanism itself to be mutable.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: Prime Agent
systems.basis: The README documents durable supplemental harness state, a /refine operation and rollback. The base prompt is immutable. An improvement-specific executable evaluation was not established in this review.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: KnowAct
systems.basis: The repository documents a Know–Route–Act–Reflect workflow, retained knowledge/skills and benchmark trajectories. This supports an executable GUI agent, without establishing recursive modification of its improver.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: Reflexion
systems.basis: Reflective text persists across subsequent trials; model weights and the updater stay fixed. Task-level gains alone do not establish retained improvement on fresh held-out tasks, so E3 is withheld.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: The AI Scientist
systems.basis: Released research workflows and evaluation code support E2. Research artifacts persist, but this does not establish held-out gains caused by persistent changes to the research agent itself.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory

systems.name: LightRSI
systems.basis: A runtime for deploying RSI loops should not receive capability checkmarks by itself; the instantiated system must be evaluated.
systems.verification: Author-reported; not independently reproduced by RSI Observatory
